newsitem.title: UK: IPE NATURAL GAS FALLS IN BRISK TRADE.
newsitem.headline: IPE NATURAL GAS FALLS IN BRISK TRADE.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures fell across the board on Wednesday as weakness on the September contract encouraged selling in the fourth quarter.
September was heavily traded with 235 lots traded on just that month. Early on, the contract fell through key psychological resistance at nine pence a therm, with last trades struck at 8.80 pence.
The remaining 185 lots were traded in the fourth quarter. November fell heaviest, slipping 0.450 to 12.90 pence a therm.
